title: A Research Study to Test the Effectiveness of MK0217 in Patients With Paget's Bone Disease (0217-206)(COMPLETED)
brief_summary: To test the safety, effectiveness of MK0217 when taken once a week for six months in treating patients with Paget's bone disease.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Male or female, ages 18 to 90 years with a diagnosis of Paget's bone disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient cannot stand or sit upright for at least 30 minutes
* Patient has difficulty swallowing or problems with digestive system
